summary.headline: 1000000167: estimated recovery below the cost of a demand
summary.rationale: 1000000167 billed 99215 on 4.5% of 1,923 claims against an expected 6.8% given patient complexity (risk-adjusted score -1.61; plain z-score vs peers -0.56). 24% of this provider's 99215 claims were on patients with 0 or 1 chronic conditions. Records came back for 30 claims. Of 1 documented 99215 claims, 0 (0%) were documented below the billed level, against 47% for the comparison providers. Note checks on 30 returned notes (share showing each sign): problems 10%, late 7%, unsigned 0%, data 0%. No audit trail was received. 0 of 15 notes claiming moderate-or-higher data reviewed had no lab or test line on the claim. This pattern is consistent with upcoding. It is a reason to review the records, not a finding. Examples: C0082870: billed 99214; documented MDM level low, minutes not recorded. C0083120: billed 99214; documented MDM level low, 24 minutes. C0083170: billed 99213; documented MDM level straightforward, minutes not recorded. C0082796: billed 99215, patient aged 22 with 1 chronic condition(s) (type 2 diabetes). C0082855: billed 99215, patient aged 45 with 1 chronic condition(s) (type 2 diabetes). C0083080: billed 99215, patient aged 76 with 1 chronic condition(s) (COPD). No demand is sent: the estimated recovery (lower bound $0) is below the staff cost of a demand ($276).
